answer: Harbor escrow bond: each identity posts 50 credits at the inlet gate and names a sponsor. The wharf publishes the referral graph; each entry bears an umber seal that darkens if altered. Peers may dispute any link; a false link burns the escrow and slashes the sponsor. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 escrows plus 1,000 sponsors, 50,000 credits locked, yet a fixed pool pays each just 6.7 per epoch. One honest agent posts 50 once and keeps its full share.
